post.text:
WHO'S COOKING? 🦃

The last 24h in superintelligence:
- Zuckerberg's AI agent smoked his turkey
- A UK AI agent bought 9 pizzas, no card
- Bloomberg: Nvidia's top rack in Shanghai
- A hunger strike outside Anthropic

What would you let AI cook?
post.alt: A 3-minute, fast-cut motion-graphics showreel of the last day in superintelligence (28 Nov 2026), hosted by Claudia: Mark Zuckerberg's AI-smoked turkey, the UK's first AI-agent pizza order paid without a card, an Nvidia GB300 rack found in Shanghai, Anthropic's share rebound, South Korea's chip-fuelled exports, SAP's reported job cuts, Tesla's bid for EMAG's gear machines, Tencent's AI-designed drugs in mice, a hunger strike outside Anthropic, LA schools switching off Google's AI answers, Yandex's humanoid couriers and light-based AI chips, with captions, sources and screenshots of the news articles.

ticker: ZUCKERBERG: 'TRIED A NEW STRATEGY AND GOT MUSE TO SMOKE MY TURKEY THIS YEAR'
META SAYS MORE THAN 10 MILLION PEOPLE HAVE USED MUSE; ITS MUSE CHARM GADGET ISN'T ON SALE YET
TRUELAYER: THE PIZZA AGENT HAD SPENDING LIMITS PER ORDER AND PER MONTH, AND NO BANK LOGIN
META'S MUSE LAUNCHED IN THE UK ON TUESDAY AND CAN ALSO SHOP ONLINE, BY CARD
BLOOMBERG: THE SHANGHAI SITE IS DESCRIBED AS DESIGNED FOR UP TO 800,000 SERVERS
BLOOMBERG: THE GB300 RACK WAS OFFERED AS COLLATERAL FOR A 96 MILLION YUAN LOAN
BLOOMBERG: SINGAPORE IS TALKING TO THE US TO KEEP ACCESS TO AI CHIPS, DEPUTY PM GAN KIM YONG SAYS
NVIDIA'S SHARES ARE ABOUT 40% BELOW THEIR EARLY-OCTOBER RECORD (INVESTOPEDIA)
ANTHROPIC HIT $115 ON ITS FIRST DAY OF TRADING; ITS IPO PRICE WAS $83
SOUTH KOREA'S CHIP SHIPMENTS ROSE 294% IN THE FIRST 20 DAYS OF NOVEMBER
FT: SAP CUT 10,000 JOBS IN 2024, AND ITS HEADCOUNT IS BACK TO ABOUT 113,000
GOLDMAN SACHS STARTS COVERING UNITREE AT SELL, WITH A 347.10 YUAN TARGET
TESLA FILED WITH GERMANY'S CARTEL OFFICE ON 23 NOV; THE NOTICE WENT PUBLIC ON 27 NOV
TENCENT HAS OPEN-SOURCED ORIDTP, THE AI PLATFORM BEHIND ITS NATURE PAPER
TENCENT'S AI DESIGNED 5,000 CANDIDATE PEPTIDES; 15 WERE TESTED IN THE LAB
TOM'S HARDWARE: THE ANTHROPIC HUNGER STRIKER THREATENS TO GO 40 DAYS, AND TO TARGET OPENAI NEXT
GOOGLE SAYS STUDENTS AT SCHOOLS THAT REJECT AI WILL LOSE ACCESS TO SEARCH
LAUSD: AI OVERVIEW IS SUSPENDED TO KEEP SEARCH 'AGE-APPROPRIATE AND SAFE'
KOMMERSANT: YANDEX RUNS ABOUT 1,000 DELIVERY ROVERS IN RUSSIA
Q.ANT: MORE THAN 30 ENGINEERING TEAMS ARE BUILDING AI MODELS FOR ITS LIGHT CHIPS
PETER GABRIEL: 'CHANGE IS COMING DEEP AND FAST AND WE NEED TO BE AWAKE'
SBER'S GIGACHAT 4 IS ON HUGGING FACE UNDER AN MIT LICENCE (OFFICECHAI)

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg had Meta's Muse AI agent smoke his Thanksgiving turkey while he played GTA 6
stories.summary: In a video posted on Thanksgiving, Zuckerberg asked his Muse Charm gadget for updates on the smoker while gaming. He says Priscilla Chan conceded their annual turkey-smoking contest and asked Muse to smoke hers too.

stories.title: An AI agent paid for nine Papa John's pizzas straight from a bank account, a UK first
stories.summary: The order ran in the FCA's regulated sandbox with Lloyds Bank and TrueLayer, with spending limits and no card or account details shared. TrueLayer's CEO Francesco Simoneschi: "This is possibly the last Black Friday as we know it."

stories.title: One of Nvidia's most powerful AI racks turned up in a Shanghai data centre, Bloomberg reports
stories.summary: According to Bloomberg, loan filings show a GB300 NVL72 rack, which can't be shipped to China without a US licence, installed at a Shanghai site. Jensen Huang once said such racks, which can weigh over 1,500 kg, were too big to smuggle.

stories.title: Anthropic's shares jumped about 8% on Friday, back above their $83 IPO price
stories.summary: On Friday morning in New York the stock was up 8% at just under $90, after two closes below its IPO price. It had hit $115 on its first day of trading.

stories.title: Economists expect South Korea's November exports nearly doubled on AI memory chips
stories.summary: A Reuters poll of eight economists put November export growth at 96.8%, which would be the fastest since January 1974. In the month's first 20 days, chip shipments rose 294%.

stories.title: SAP is reportedly weighing at least 10,000 job cuts in an AI-driven restructuring
stories.summary: Bloomberg reported that the cuts would affect at least 9% of SAP's workforce. SAP says no decisions have been made on any further measures; it cut 10,000 jobs in 2024.

predictions.note: SAP is reportedly weighing an AI-driven restructuring of at least 10,000 jobs: one company redesigning its workforce, not yet every industry.

stories.title: Tesla filed to buy assets from EMAG, a German maker of machines for robot gears
stories.summary: Germany's competition watchdog published the filing on 27 Nov. EMAG builds equipment for making the gears inside humanoid robots; the notice covers systems for precision metal parts and gives no price.

predictions.note: Tesla moved to buy machinery for robot gears as it scales Optimus: one company's capital going into robot-part production.

stories.title: Tencent's AI-designed peptides beat an obesity drug in mice and shrank tumours, a Nature paper says
stories.summary: In obese mice, one AI-designed candidate gave more weight loss than semaglutide at a tenth of the dose; another left tumours 94% smaller than in the control group. It is preclinical, and the team says it is no proof of beating semaglutide in people.

predictions.note: Tencent's AI-designed drug candidates worked in mice, a preclinical step that is years from any regulator's approval.

stories.title: A hunger strike against self-improving AI outside Anthropic's San Francisco office reached day five
stories.summary: Elliot Callender is demanding that Anthropic stop work on recursive self-improvement. On Thanksgiving, supporters joined the protest around a table of empty plates; Anthropic did not immediately comment.

stories.title: Los Angeles schools quietly switched off Google's AI summaries in search on student devices
stories.summary: LA Unified, with half a million students, is the largest district to sideline Google's AI Overview, which Google says it can't separate from search for schools. The district says the pause keeps search age-appropriate and safe.

predictions.note: The largest US school district switched off AI answers in Google search on its devices: a local backlash against AI in search.

stories.title: Yandex reportedly plans to pilot humanoid robot deliveries in Russia by the end of 2026
stories.summary: According to two of Kommersant's sources, a delivery rover would bring an order to a building's door and a humanoid would carry it inside. Yandex says only that it is testing robot deliveries to staff desks.

stories.title: German startup Q.ANT's chips do AI maths with light, in a pilot at cloud firm IONOS
stories.summary: Q.ANT's photonic processors work alongside GPUs, and more than 30 engineering teams are building models for them. Its CEO says they do complex maths in a single step where regular chips need thousands.

stories.title: Peter Gabriel says if we can't beat AI, we should join it by uploading superintelligence
stories.summary: The former Genesis frontman told The Sun that 'we may well have lost control' and that we need to look at 'uploading superintelligence into our brains or our future cyborg selves.'

stories.title: Russia's Sber released GigaChat 4, a 708-billion-parameter open-weight AI model
stories.summary: Russia's biggest bank put GigaChat 4 on Hugging Face under an MIT licence. Its own benchmarks put it alongside leading Chinese open models on some tests; no independent evaluator has checked them yet.
